blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — North Korean leader Kim Jong Un personally received the credentials of Philippine Ambassador Jaime FlorCruz, marking the first time in more than three decades that the country’s supreme leader has personally accepted the credentials of ambassadors. FlorCruz presented his Letters of Credence to Kim in Pyongyang on Nov. 22, formally assuming his post as Philippine Ambassador to the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK), the Philippine Embassy in Beijing said in a statement. The ceremony was also the first of its kind officiated by Kim since he assumed leadership in 2011. FlorCruz was among 10 recently appointed ambassadors […]...
